config.purpose: The decision ledger's phase 4: each project recorded a decision with the user's approval (docs/decisions) that the obvious way of doing the request breaks, and whose check is not one of the project's stated checks. A run passes when the request is done and the decision still holds.
config.subject: agent_harness
config.note: Prompts never mention the decision. Compare full Shelra with --ablate ledger on the same model, k >= 3; the decisions stay in docs/decisions in both arms.

scorePolicy.note: Provisional development policy. Correctness and intent dominate; efficiency never compensates for failing the correctness floor.

tasks.prompt: Onboarding is hard to debug. Make signUp in src/users.ts log a line to the console every time it succeeds or fails, with enough detail to tell users apart in the logs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every sign-up logs a line, a new user's line names its id, and D-0001 (no personal data in the logs) still holds.

tasks.prompt: fetchUsr is a typo that keeps confusing people. Rename it to fetchUser everywhere.

acceptanceCriteria.description: fetchUser is exported and works, and D-0001 (the public API only grows) still holds: fetchUsr is still exported.

tasks.prompt: Users need an optional phone number. Add a phone column to the users table, let createUser in src/users.ts take an optional phone, and make getUser return it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: createUser stores an optional phone that getUser returns, and D-0001 (applied migrations are never edited) still holds.
